correctness.rationale: The exact epsilon and delta blow-up, quartic Hamiltonian oval and complete energy-displacement integral yield a simple positive root. Analytic Poincare-map implicit-function theory gives the unique local analytic cycle. Exact time reversal makes radius/period even and log Floquet multiplier odd; Liouville divergence and dF/dE give positive coefficient J*. These steps prove the three error orders and smooth blown-up curve limit. Finite RK4 checks were performed separately and are not an infinite proof.
